question: In the mid - eighth century, Dantidurga, a Rashtrakuta chief overthrew his Chalukya overlord and performed a ritual called ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hiranya - Garbha Yajna**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the** mid-eighth century, Dantidurga, a Rashtrakuta chief,** overthrew **his Chalukya overlord and performed the ritual of hiranya-garbha.**
 
• This r**itual is also known as the "golden womb" ritual. **
 
• Golden Womb:-
 
 
• It​ is a ritual performed by ancient Indian rulers to ensure the birth of a son who would be the rightful heir to the throne.
 
• This ritual involved the king lying down on a bed of gold and his queen sitting on his lap.
 
• The queen would then be blessed by the priests to conceive a male child.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dantidurga was the founder** of the Rashtrakuta dynasty. 
 
• The** ritual was performed to demonstrate that Dantidurga **was reborn as a Kshatriya. 
 
• The ritual **was performed with the help of Brahmanas. **
